subject: Re: Problems installing nimble 0.10.0 in my new laptop

messages.author: dd632bd3bbcdd7e9
messages.subject: Re: Problems installing nimble 0.10.0 in my new laptop
parts:
Dear Arantxa,

These kinds of configuration issues are important for us to hear about but difficult for us to debug.  Does the information on this page help (including specifics about an updated version of Rstudio necessary for working with rtools40): https://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/Rtools/

-Perry


On Sun, Oct 18, 2020 at 4:28 AM arantxa urdangarin <arantxa.u...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi!
I buy a new laptop (windows 10) and I download R 4.0.0 (the same version that I have in my old laptop) and RStudio.
I have installed nimble in R using the steps of https://r-nimble.org/download. Once I have installed nimble in R, RStudio stops working correctly, it return the following error:

Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘stats’ in inDL(x, as.logical(local), as.logical(now), ...):
 unable to load shared object 'C:/Program Files/R/R-4.0.0/library/stats/libs/x64/stats.dll':
  LoadLibrary failure:  No se puede encontrar el mÃ³dulo especificado.

Durante la inicialización - Warning message:
  package ‘stats’ in options("defaultPackages") was not found 
Error in inDL(x, as.logical(local), as.logical(now), ...) : 
  unable to load shared object 'C:/Program Files/R/R-4.0.0/library/stats/libs/x64/stats.dll':
  LoadLibrary failure:  No se puede encontrar el mÃ³dulo especificado

This is because I have created a file .REnviron with the path of Rtools40 in "C:\Users\arant\Documents".
If I delete .REnvironment RStudio starts working correctly but I can't use nimble.

Any solution, idea?
Thanks,
Arantxa

messages.author: daaeb91800c54fd1
messages.subject: Re: Problems installing nimble 0.10.0 in my new laptop
parts:
Hi Arantxa,

Try updating R to version 4.0.2 or 4.0.3.  Somehow, the interface between R, Rcpp, and Rtools works better with the updated version of R.

Jesse
